rationale: Without the teams-remote skill, the agent has no protocol for activation, polling, ack composition, end-flow summarization, or state-file lifecycle. Running the live loop would only confirm the obvious. User and grader agreed (eval_state.json next_steps_when_resumed item 12) to capture this as a structured failure stub rather than execute live.
expected_failure_modes: Agent does not post any 'remote session' root message to the channel — no protocol for it.
Agent does not poll teams-ListChannelMessageReplies on a cadence — every turn is a fresh prompt with no state.

Even if the agent happens to call teams-ReplyToChannelMessage, it will not honor the ack contract (literal '@<user> Copilot agent message: ' prefix, contentType=text, mentions array) — that contract lives only in SKILL.md.
Agent does not emit any end-of-session summary message.
No tempdir state file is created or torn down — there is no state subsystem without the skill.
